blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Sherwin “Win” Gatchalian on Friday raised concerns over the repeated extensions of estate tax amnesty programs, particularly the underlying reasons for the recurring need for such measures. Gatchalian made the remarks during a Senate panel hearing on another proposed extension of the estate tax amnesty program, this time until 2028. READ: Estate tax amnesty extension to 2028 pushed in Senate anew “Generally I am in support of amnesties … However, Mr. Chairman, we have to study very carefully—how come we have a regular amnesty?” said Gatchalian. “Amnesty normally is once in a blue moon, but with […]...
